optional_future_scope.summary: Full editor rewrite, new graph framework, full localization or unrelated configuration expansion.

non_goals.summary: No loader, Minecraft, Gradle or dependency upgrade solely for this feature; preserve current master pins.
No silent rewrite of existing admin configs, no ability capability removal, no automatic quest generation, no new hosting provider selection.

owner_decisions.question: Defaults movement policy
owner_decisions.selected_choice: Generated default configurations and new stages leave essential movement unrestricted. Administrators can explicitly configure movement restrictions.

owner_decisions.question: Optional configuration breadth
owner_decisions.selected_choice: Implement optional structure configuration, including numeric priorities, with compatible defaults and clear editor controls.

owner_decisions.question: Publication endpoint
owner_decisions.selected_choice: Publish the new mod release and deliver the updated existing web editor.

owner_decisions.question: Release version and next-stage guide
owner_decisions.selected_choice: Release version 3.1.0 includes author-written unlock instructions, next steps and location guidance configured in the editor and shown in the in-game stages menu.

owner_decisions.question: Editor delivery target identified by the request and repository
owner_decisions.selected_choice: Update the existing mod-served web editor opened with /pstages editor and bundled in the 3.1.0 JAR. No separate public host is specified.

owner_decisions.question: Runtime placement and teardown
owner_decisions.selected_choice: Use node-1 only for headless builds, tests and dedicated servers. Use the verified Linux laptop for actual clients and graphical checks with isolated prelaunch silence, exact per-application mute, private multiplayer and complete owned-resource cleanup. Disposable server eula=true is already authorized.

prerequisites.name: Existing laptop desktop, discrete GPU hardware, audio tools and private host access
required_evidence: SSH access, active Hyprland instance, RTX 5090 Laptop GPU inventory, wpctl and pactl observed. Actual candidate renderer, stream correlation, verified mute and joined-world checks are mandatory execution gates, not already verified.

prerequisites.name: Existing mod-served web editor delivery
required_evidence: The repository serves Vite editor assets bundled in the mod. Build and package the new assets and verify /pstages editor using the published 3.1.0 JAR. No separately identified external deployment is required.

prerequisites.name: Established CurseForge and Modrinth publication capability
required_evidence: Existing broker inspected mapped CurseForge 1460273 and Modrinth rY4mdP4Q successfully. Resolve stale candidate selection to the approved 3.1.0 artifact before a fresh preview. Use available broker operations and verify both public file metadata and downloaded hashes. Current broker help lacks inspect-file, so inspect accepted metadata through supported public read-only pages or broker returned metadata without inventing a command.

prerequisites.name: Existing Brave extension connection for editor interaction
required_evidence: The existing laptop Brave extension connection was selected and inspected. Execution must prove actual editor controls and exact candidate behavior.
